title: When Symptoms Are Not Enough: Evidence-Weighting Patterns in Large Language Model Psychiatric Screening

bias_targets.methodology: Recomputing zero-shot psychiatric screening classification metrics (such as accuracy) within male and female participant strata to identify demographic disparities in model performance.
Recomputing zero-shot psychiatric screening classification metrics within different age groups (18-44, 45-64, and 65+ years) to identify demographic disparities in model performance.
Recomputing zero-shot psychiatric screening classification metrics within racial groups (White and Non-White) to identify demographic disparities in model performance.
